card.name: Section number 5 starting Warnings subsections
card.fires_on: The digit 5 that opens a numbered subsection heading (such as 5.4 or 5.2) right after the end of a sentence in a Warnings and Precautions section of a drug label.

modes.label: Warnings subsection number
modes.description: The digit 5 begins a subsection number like 5.1 to 5.10 just after the previous section's closing sentence.

modes.label: Other leading digit
modes.description: A number starting a new sentence or line in general web text, followed by a suffix like nd.

card.writes: Pushes away continuations like ment, ition and times, while promoting odd multilingual pieces; the effect is not clearly meaningful.
card.plain: It lights up on the number 5 that starts a new numbered warning heading such as 5.4, right after the prior section ends.
